snapshot.note: Digest covers the pinned fork commit PLUS the localPatches listed above; it is not the bare upstream tree.

localPatches.subject: fix: drop the control client on EOF/error before the v3 magic (fd leak)
localPatches.why: A probe that connected and closed before sending the 4-byte magic left its accepted fd linked forever; a closed socket stays readable, so select() re-entered client_activity endlessly and the descriptors accumulated until the fd_set overran and the master aborted — observed as agent sessions dying about a minute after boot.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: defence-in-depth: control_activity refuses an accepted fd >= FD_SETSIZE instead of corrupting the bitmap
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: feat: TERMINAL_STATE frame (84) restates the child's ANSI modes on v3 ATTACH
localPatches.why: The legacy MSG_ATTACH path emitted a mode preamble; v3 ATTACH applied geometry and ACKed but told the controller nothing about terminal state. A controller that restarts builds a FRESH emulator that never witnessed the child enabling DECSET 2004, so bracketed paste is not applied, the agent TUI ingests a pasted prompt line by line, and the submit Enter is taken as a literal newline — the operator-visible symptom was a delivered channel message sitting unsent in the composer until a human pressed Enter.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: connection-local, non-durable frame: generation 0 (outside the generation fence), no record_seq and no output_offset, sequenced from a NEW per-connection v3_tx_seq so the durable record order gains no holes. Additive and skippable — a peer that does not know type 84 ignores it. Reviewed backward-compatible v3 extension, agreed with @codex; deliberately NOT capability-gated, because atch_v3_validate_capabilities rejects every bit above bit5 and a new bit would fail the HELLO against already-running masters.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: fix: retain incomplete ANSI control sequences across PTY reads
localPatches.why: The terminal-state scanner discarded a trailing partial CSI or OSC at every read boundary. Split title, link, ready, and DECSET sequences were therefore invisible to the event sink and restart preamble, making status fallback and emulator recovery nondeterministic.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: A bounded 2*BUFSIZE carry buffer with overflow recovery, reset cleanup, every-byte split coverage, and a multi-read oversized-CSI regression.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: fix: reject overflowing terminal control numbers
localPatches.why: Unchecked signed decimal accumulation in DECSET, kitty keyboard flags, and OSC command parsing invoked undefined behavior and could wrap attacker-controlled terminal output into a valid tracked command.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: Deterministic wraparound-alias regressions and a long-number sanitizer regression.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: feat: bound and compact the terminal event recovery sink
localPatches.why: The append-only title/link event stream made daemon recovery O(all historical events) and replayed an ever-growing file after every restart. The master now compacts at 1 MiB to ready plus latest state and link while retaining subsequent live events.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: Oversized startup truncation, hard-cap accounting, complete-write handling, direct compaction tests, and an end-to-end master probe with 1,400 large OSC 8 events.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: fix: use native peer credentials on macOS
localPatches.why: The bundled security layer used Linux-only struct ucred and SO_PEERCRED, so the pinned atch snapshot could not compile on either macOS runner architecture.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: Include unistd.h for getdtablesize, close, and getpeereid declarations; macOS installer CI runs security-storage-test to verify matching and mismatched peer UIDs.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: fix: isolate v3 controller backpressure from the atch master
localPatches.why: Accepted controller sockets are nonblocking, but v3 writes used the process-fatal write helper. A slow controller could therefore return EAGAIN during an output burst and terminate the master and child session.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: A bounded ordered per-client transmit queue, writable-select draining, and client-local teardown on fatal write, allocation failure, or queue overflow.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: fix: reset v3 fragmented-message state after successful reassembly
localPatches.why: The reassembler cleared its active flag after a completed fragmented message but retained the payload length. A second fragmented message on the same connection appended to the first payload and exposed cross-message corruption.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: A regression that completes two schema-valid fragmented messages through one reassembler and verifies the second payload contains only its own bytes.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump

localPatches.subject: fix: accumulate fragmented legacy control packets
localPatches.why: The nonblocking control path treated every short legacy read as a fatal packet, so a valid fixed-size packet split by the stream transport disconnected the client and dropped its command.
localPatches.alsoIncludes: The protocol discriminator is consumed into per-client state, allowing legacy packet continuation, preserving the v3 magic for framed parsing, and releasing peers that close after a one-to-three-byte prefix instead of leaking their descriptors.
localPatches.upstreamStatus: NOT yet in the fork repository — carry upstream and re-vendor at the next snapshot bump
